summary: A 60-foot Aermotor lookout on Broad Mountain, built 1921 per the NHLR; still standing and reached on foot, though build-date accounts disagree.

access.note: Reached on foot by trails from the park on PA 305 and the Standing Stone Trail; no source read says whether the tower itself can be climbed.

visit.trail_note: Fire Tower Loop Trail from the park; the Greenwood Spur climb from Alan Seeger Natural Area is short but very steep.

events.note: NHLR gives 1921 for a 60-foot Aermotor tower. A 1922 visitor account says eighty feet, and a hiking guide says the 1930s.
A Coast and Geodetic Survey station was described at the tower site on Broad Mountain.
Registered December 6, 2017 as US 1252, PA 21, nominated by Ron Stafford.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register's 1921 date and 60-foot height are used. The 1922 eighty-foot account and the 1930s date in a hiking guide are reported in the story as disputed, not adopted.

sources.title: Fire Tower Loop Trail, Huntingdon County Pennsylvania Hiking Trails

notes_for_editor: Record fields for design, height, elevation, agency and registration all match the NHLR, so no corrections are proposed. Build date is unresolved: NHLR says 1921 and 60 ft, a 1922 visitor account says eighty feet, and a hiking guide says the 1930s. Staffing is not verified; the guide's still in use claim is unconfirmed. Climbability is not verified, so the access note says so. No official land-manager page was read. No photos added because credits and licences were not checked. Fact-check 2026-10-08: the earlier story said the PA 305 park entrance is the start of the loop and that getting there is on foot; the guide puts the loop trailhead near the Visitor Center and the routes read are hikes, and the story now says that. The 1922 account's date and the survey station wording are now in evidence.
